protocol.optimizer: plain SGD; no momentum, weight decay or gradient clipping; full-parameter training in eval mode
protocol.method_settings: fixed published/retained defaults; periodic every5updates, damping.5; each method receives same3LR development budget
protocol.loss: answer-only cross-entropy; EOS/padding ignored; identical shared attention precision for every method
protocol.selection: minimum development validation worst-task CE across post-start checkpoints; lower LR breaks ties; no test access
protocol.primary_endpoint: final heldout worst-task answer CE; paired Direct-minus-Uniform and periodic-minus-FA differences
protocol.secondary: all six methods, all three seeds, per-task CE and teacher-forced answer exact match; validation-selected and final results; update/total wall/memory
protocol.scope: bounded-budget full-parameter adaptation, not convergence or standard full-dataset benchmark training
protocol.checkpoint_recovery_scope: Models/rule/RNG remain on VM; Drive contains numerical/provenance records only; VM loss requires independently retained model bytes

data.scope: New maintained-dataset split protocol, not historical v0 reproduction
data.loss: mean answer-token CE per example, then mean per task; EOS ignored

tokenizer_contract.scope: identical vocabulary, merges, added tokens, normalizer, pre-tokenizer and decoder; frozen data IDs unchanged; generation EOS metadata is unused by teacher-forced loss and all padding/EOS labels are ignored

attention.scope: shared by all methods; forward and backward arithmetic change

scope.uncertainty: Descriptive Student-t 95% intervals across exactly three paired reporting seeds, df=2. No power, significance, equivalence, convergence, or population guarantee is asserted; no p-values or outcome-selected comparisons are computed.
scope.accuracy: Teacher-forced answer-token exact match; not free-generation accuracy.
scope.update_and_preparation: Separate sums over the retained training trajectory. Includes every recorded update and preparation; discarded work before the last recovered checkpoint can be absent.
scope.trainer_wall: main through latest recorded event, including loading, preparation, audits, evaluation and earlier checkpoint copies; excludes imports/final persistence; resumed uncheckpointed work may be missing
scope.validation_checkpoint_wall: Cumulative trainer wall logged at each validation event, before that event's checkpoint persistence; events are not additive durations.
scope.process_wall: Sum of recorded subprocess wall durations, including imports/setup, loading, updates, audits, evaluation and checkpoint persistence. Failed completed attempts are included. Unfinished/missing attempts make the total unknown; known durations remain reported. Conditional on the retained process-attempt log.
scope.retirement: Campaign validation, parent-side backup restoration or completion of interrupted publication, and completed-model archival/retirement occur outside the timed training subprocess. No retirement timer exists in this frozen campaign; no campaign-total wall estimate is formed.
scope.memory: Maximum torch CUDA allocated bytes sampled within training updates after per-update reset, including resident allocations. Excludes independent native reference/audit, loading, preparation and evaluation peaks; not reserved memory, total device usage, or global run peak. Raw independent audit records are retained separately.
scope.periodic: Scheduled five-update opportunities and actually applied refinements are separate counts; neither is a per-update fidelity certificate.
scope.completed_models: Under an explicitly frozen final-only policy, final checkpoint bytes are fully verified; selected-model absence is accepted only with the completion verification receipt binding its source/archive hashes and recorded evaluation metrics. The selected model was verified before intentional retirement and cannot subsequently be re-evaluated without an independent copy. Other unexplained model absence is rejected.
scope.provenance: Checks artifact hashes, audited sources, cardinalities, deterministic batch sampling and complete declared coverage. These checks do not independently prove remote execution or cloud synchronization.
